metadata.title: महुआ लाटा कैसे बनाते हैं । Mahua Latta by Primitive tribe । The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
The Pando tribe of Chhattisgarh state is categorised as a primitive tribe of India. This tribe still survives using age-old, primitive techniques in the Jungles. In this Episode, we show you how they steam and make a special dish from Mahua that is collected from the forests around them.
Anchor - Shyam Sunder

For updates regarding upcoming videos and stories follows our social media accounts linked below::
